_comment: Embarque → Aduana for La Habana (2026-11-28), read by Mission Control (the growth view and a
presented session's class votes). Like La selva, La Habana does NOT load /js/espanol-checks.js:
the story draws its own picture-tap boarding pass (Form A at Embarque, Form B at Aduana, four
items each, as built in prototype v1.0) and saves the `checks` record on the student's
module_progress/la-habana: { v, form: 'A', emb: [0|1 x4], adu: [0|1 x4], tr: [0|1 x2], embDone,
aduDone, trDone }. Slot i is item i of both forms (the same adjective, the other verb). Each item
is spoken (▶) and answered with a picture; `q` is the Spanish the student hears, `o` describes
the pictures, the right one is index 0 (`a`). The page shuffles the order it shows. After the
Aduana comes the TRANSFER: two sentences about Doña Caridad's house, each answered by tapping es
or está (`tr`, in the order of `transfer.items`). Nothing is typed anywhere in this story.
title: La Habana
focus: Ser vs. estar: what something is, or how and where it is right now

slots.mis: Hears the adjective but not the verb that changes its meaning
Reads rica as one meaning whatever the verb
Reads malo as one meaning whatever the verb
Hears aburrido but not whether it is a state or a trait

a mean dog, growling
a sick dog in bed with a thermometer
